errors.text_span: 图表的图例清晰地标注了不同颜色所代表的含义，使得数据的解读更加直观。
errors.evidence: This sentence uses subjective and evaluative language ('清晰地' - clearly, '更加直观' - more intuitive) to comment on the quality of the chart's design, rather than objectively describing its content. A description should focus on the data and structure, not the perceived effectiveness of the visualization.
